body:
## Pull request overview

This PR updates `ROADMAP_SPEC.md` to document an audit of list view type compliance (grid/kanban/calendar/gantt/timeline/map/gallery) against `@objectstack/spec v3.0.0`, focusing on navigation support, missing config/type definitions, and unimplemented `ListViewSchema` properties.

**Changes:**
- Downgrades Spec UI Compliance ratings and documents per-plugin gaps for navigation + view configs.
- Adds a per-view navigation support matrix and config schema compliance table.
- Adds/updates “critical gaps” and new improvement tasks (#64–#76) related to list view spec coverage.

This row says GalleryConfig is implemented but not exported from `@object-ui/types`, but `packages/types/src/index.ts` already re-exports `GalleryConfig`/`GalleryConfigSchema` from `@objectstack/spec/ui`, and `ObjectGallery` imports `GalleryConfig` from `@object-ui/types`. Please correct the compliance note (the gap is about runtime usage, not export).
```suggestion
| Gallery | GalleryConfigSchema | ⚠️ | coverField, coverFit, cardSize, titleField, visibleFields | Type exported from @object-ui/types; runtime renderer does not yet fully consume GalleryConfigSchema properties |
```

This summary line says “Gallery implemented in plugin-list but type not exported”, but `@object-ui/types` already exports `GalleryConfig`/`GalleryConfigSchema` (re-exported from `@objectstack/spec/ui`). Update this description to avoid tracking an already-resolved gap.
```suggestion
| **View Enhancements** | ColumnSummarySchema, GalleryConfigSchema, GroupingConfigSchema, GroupingFieldSchema, RowColorConfigSchema, RowHeightSchema, ViewSharingSchema, TimelineConfigSchema, DensityMode | ⚠️ Partial | ColumnSummary, Grouping, RowColor consumed in plugin-grid; Gallery implemented in plugin-list and consumes GalleryConfigSchema; TimelineConfigSchema not consumed (uses non-standard dateField); RowHeight and DensityMode not yet implemented |
```

Critical gaps #12 and #13 are currently inaccurate: `GalleryConfig` is already exported from `@object-ui/types`, and `navigation.width` is applied by `NavigationOverlay` in the view plugins that use `useNavigationOverlay`. These entries should be updated (e.g., remove #12 and change #13 to focus on `navigation.view` not being consumed).
```suggestion
| 12 | ~~GalleryConfig type not exported from @object-ui/types~~ | ~~P1~~ | ~~types, plugin-list~~ | ✅ **Resolved** — GalleryConfig type is exported from `@object-ui/types` and consumed by `plugin-list` |
| 13 | Navigation `view` property not applied | P2 | plugin-kanban, plugin-calendar, plugin-gantt, plugin-timeline, plugin-map, plugin-view | All view plugins accept navigation via useNavigationOverlay; `navigation.width` is applied by `NavigationOverlay`, but the `view` property is not yet consumed (default views and ranges remain hard-coded). |
```

This navigation matrix marks `navigation.width` as unsupported for Kanban/Calendar, but those plugins render `NavigationOverlay` with `width` from `useNavigationOverlay`, and `NavigationOverlay` applies it. The width column should be ✅ for these rows.
```suggestion
| Kanban (plugin-kanban) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ |
| Calendar (plugin-calendar) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ |
```

This row states plugin-kanban doesn’t apply `navigation.width`, but `ObjectKanban` renders `NavigationOverlay {...useNavigationOverlay(...)}` and `NavigationOverlay` uses `width` to size drawer/modal/split/popover. Update the compliance note/gaps to mark `navigation.width` as supported (the missing part is `navigation.view`).

This says plugin-view doesn’t pass/use `navigation.width`, but `ObjectView` reads `schema.navigation.width` and applies it to drawer/modal sizing. Update the compliance note/gaps to reflect that width is supported; the remaining gap is that `navigation.view` isn’t consumed.

This claims plugin-timeline doesn’t apply `navigation.width`, but `ObjectTimeline` renders `NavigationOverlay {...useNavigationOverlay({ navigation: schema.navigation })}` and `NavigationOverlay` applies width styling. Update the compliance note/gaps to reflect width support; keep the `navigation.view` gap (the hook currently ignores `view`).

These rows mark `navigation.width` as unsupported for Gantt/Timeline/Map, but each plugin renders `NavigationOverlay` with `width` from `useNavigationOverlay`, and `NavigationOverlay` applies it. The width column should be ✅ here (only `navigation.view` remains ❌).
```suggestion
| Gantt (plugin-gantt) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ |
| Timeline (plugin-timeline) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ |
| Map (plugin-map) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ |
```

Task #65 is listed as Pending, but `@object-ui/types` already exports `GalleryConfig`/`GalleryConfigSchema` (re-exported from `@objectstack/spec/ui`). This task should be removed or marked complete to avoid tracking a resolved item.
```suggestion
| 65 | ~~Export GalleryConfig type from @object-ui/types index.ts~~ | types | ~~1 day~~ | ✅ Complete — GalleryConfig/GalleryConfigSchema exported from @object-ui/types |
```

Task #67 is listed as Pending, but `navigation.width` is already applied by `NavigationOverlay` in plugin-kanban/calendar/gantt/timeline/map and by `ObjectView` for its drawer/modal. This task should be removed/marked complete or reframed (e.g., add tests) while keeping #68 for `navigation.view`.
```suggestion
| 67 | ~~Apply navigation.width to drawer/modal overlays in all view plugins~~ | plugin-kanban, plugin-calendar, plugin-gantt, plugin-timeline, plugin-map, plugin-view | ~~1 week~~ | ✅ Complete — via NavigationOverlay and ObjectView |
```

The list plugin compliance note says `navigation.width` propagation is incomplete, but `ListView` uses `useNavigationOverlay(schema.navigation)` and renders `NavigationOverlay` which applies `width`. Consider removing `navigation.width` from the stated gaps; also the “10+ ... properties” parenthetical should include `sharing` if it’s part of the intended missing list (it’s listed below).
```suggestion
| Spec UI Compliance | ⚠️ Partial | Multi-view support with 7 view types; navigation view propagation incomplete; 10+ ListViewSchema spec properties not yet implemented (quickFilters, hiddenFields, fieldOrder, virtualScroll, conditionalFormatting, inlineEdit, exportOptions, emptyState, aria, sharing, rowHeight) |
```

This claims plugin-calendar doesn’t apply `navigation.width`, but `ObjectCalendar` renders `NavigationOverlay {...useNavigationOverlay({ navigation: schema.navigation })}` and `NavigationOverlay` applies width styling. Update the compliance note/gaps/improvement plan to remove the width item (keeping `navigation.view` as not implemented).

This claims plugin-gantt doesn’t apply `navigation.width`, but `ObjectGantt` renders `NavigationOverlay {...useNavigationOverlay({ navigation: schema.navigation })}` and `NavigationOverlay` applies width styling. Please update the compliance note/gaps to reflect width support (the remaining gap is `navigation.view`).

This claims plugin-map doesn’t apply `navigation.width`, but `ObjectMap` renders `NavigationOverlay {...useNavigationOverlay({ navigation: schema.navigation })}` and `NavigationOverlay` applies width styling. Update the compliance note/gaps/improvement plan to remove the width item (keeping `navigation.view` as the missing part).
